name: Clover Reset
source:
Shonan Saika Academy, a high-achieving all-girls school in Kanagawa Prefecture. 
One day, Marin Tachibana, along with her best friends Mashiro Saotome and Kiyoka Jinguji, experiences a special day. 
It begins with meeting an unusual new transfer student, Shizuku Kujyo. A beautiful girl with a calm and dignified demeanor. Meeting her feels like déjà vu...
While showing her around the school, they stop by an observation deck, where Marin finds a four-leaf clover.There is a tradition at this school:
If you press a four-leaf clover found on the observation deck into your student notebook, your wish will come true.

(I want to get closer to her. To spend more time with her...)
With this wish, Marin gives Shizuku the "coincidental" four-leaf clover she found.
This act becomes a turning point, bringing Marin and Shizuku closer together with the help of Mashiro and Kiyoka. However...

"Please, stop worrying about me. I don't want to just be protected..."
"Shizuku, we're friends, right?"

A storm threatens to tear them apart. It is deeply tied to a "secret" Shizuku is hiding and a "trauma" from Marin's past. The story follows the growth, mutual support, and cherished memories of the four girls. Will Marin and the others find their personal "clover" (happiness)?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3239250/Clover_Reset/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
湘南彩嘉学院是神奈川县一所成绩优异的女子学校。
有一天，Marin Tachibana与她最好的朋友早乙女真白和神宫寺清香一起度过了特别的一天。
故事从遇见一位不寻常的新转校生九条雫开始。一个美丽的女孩，气质沉稳又端庄。见到她，有种似曾相识的感觉……
在带她参观学校时，他们在一个观景台停下来，马林在那里发现了一棵四叶草。这所学校有一个传统：
如果你把在观景台找到的四叶草压进你的学生笔记本里，你的愿望就会实现。

（我想离她更近一些，花更多的时间和她在一起……）带着这个愿望，玛琳将她发现的“巧合”的四叶草交给了雫。
这一行为成为一个转折点，在真白和清香的帮助下，马林和雫的关系更加紧密。然而…

“求你了，别再担心我了。我不想只是被保护……”
“雫，我们是朋友吧？”

一场暴风雨可能会将他们分开。这与雫隐藏的“秘密”以及马林过去的“创伤”密切相关。故事讲述了四个女孩的成长、相互支持和珍贵的回忆。马林等人能否找到属于自己的“三叶草”（幸福）呢？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3239250/Clover_Reset/]Steam[/url]]
